findings.title: Re-entry discards evidence required by the findings-addressed gate
findings.description:
D3 deliberately supplies empty prior-iteration outputs on resume and defers reconstruction to 911/305. However, slice 305’s Technical Decision 5 explicitly requires resumed loops to rehydrate prior findings. Its gate also needs prior commit evidence for round comparisons. An iteration number alone does not restore this contract.

Preserve the required prior-round evidence, or specify an explicit fail-closed outcome when reconstruction is impossible. Add a resume test using the findings-addressed gate, not only an ordinary review loop.

findings.title: The resume predicate conflates inner checkpoints with loop exhaustion
findings.description:
Part A makes every paused loop unfinished, while Part B replays its recorded round. This also catches `on_exhaust: checkpoint`, which pauses **after** the configured rounds have completed—not inside an unfinished round. `docs/PIPELINES.md` documents exhaustion as escalation to a human; the proposed behavior instead replays the final round and can exhaust again.

Distinguish an interrupted body from an exhaustion checkpoint and define their respective resume behavior. Add regression coverage for exhaustion at `max`, preserving the stated exclusion of checkpoint-semantic changes.
